newsitem.title: USA: Pennsylvania business starts rise 3.6 pct -- report.
newsitem.headline: Pennsylvania business starts rise 3.6 pct -- report.

text.p: Business starts in Pennsylvania increased 3.6 percent between 1992 and 1996, the data center at Penn State's Harrisburg campus said in a new report.
The vast majority of the new businesses are in the service industry, which was responsible for the creation of more than 160,000 new jobs over the period, the report said.
Montgomery County lead the state with 11,000 new starts, a 5.3 percent increase. But Philadelphia lost 476 businesses, a 1.8 percent decline.
